glossary.definition: (A) "Board of health" means the board of health of a city or general health district or the authority having the duties of a board of health under section 3709.05 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Body piercing" includes ear piercing except when the ear piercing procedure is performed with an ear piercing gun.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Business" means any entity that provides services for compensation.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Custodian" has the same meaning as in section 2151.011 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Ear piercing gun" means a mechanical device that pierces the ear by forcing a disposable single-use stud or solid needle through the ear.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Guardian" has the same meaning as in section 2111.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3730.01 - Tattooing or body piercing services definitions.
